$comment: How close generated data must be to the resolved profile. Paths are dot paths into the profile. The most specific rule wins. 'points' is an absolute difference for percentages; 'relative' is a share of the target (0.2 = within 20%).

$skipReasons.attendance.sundayHourMix: Service times come from configuration/schedules.json, not the profile.
$skipReasons.attendance.checkInDayMix: Midweek check-in is a Phase 1 feature.
$skipReasons.groups.smallGroups.groupTypes: The sample church has one small group type by design; the source church has several.
$skipReasons.groups.servingTeams.groupTypes: The sample church has one Serving Team type by design, with a parent group per campus.
$skipReasons.attendance.adultCheckInsPerChildCheckIn: Adults in the sample church check in only to serve. It has no midweek programs, adult classes, or events where adults check in (see the midweek item in the roadmap).
$skipReasons.attendance.adultFrequencyMixOf26Weeks: Measured from adult check-ins; see attendance.adultCheckInsPerChildCheckIn. Volunteers check in on their rotation, and there are no one-time adult check-ins.
$skipReasons.groups.servingTeams.weightedMedianSize: Each campus has eight serving teams by design (decision 69), so a large campus has large teams.
